Container.Name: Wise Route Manager Lite
Container.Overview: Friendly route-only workspace for discovering, auditing, adopting, and safely reconciling Technitium DNS, an Unraid LAN reverse proxy, and Pangolin routes. Discovery is read-only, and every live change requires an explicit approval.

Config.Name: 1. Appdata
Config.Description: Keep this path: it stores route state, encrypted provider credentials, audit history, backups, and generated proxy configuration. Do not delete it when recreating the container.

Config.Name: 2. Edition (fixed)
Config.Description: Lite keeps the interface focused on route discovery, health, review, and correction. Leave this value as lite.

Config.Name: 3. Master key path
Config.Description: Advanced: path inside the container to the mode-0600 encryption key. Keep the default unless the key is mounted separately and backed up securely.

Config.Name: 4. Enable live changes
Config.Description: Recommended: 0 during setup. Change to 1 only after integrations, read-only discovery, backups, certificates, and the first preview have been verified.

Config.Name: 5. Certificate check interval
Config.Description: Advanced: seconds between validated renewal checks (minimum 300). Automatic installation also needs first-sync approval and live changes enabled.

Config.Name: 6. LAN TLS certificate
Config.Description: Required for LAN HTTPS: a user-supplied PEM certificate or full chain covering every managed LAN hostname. It must be readable by container UID 1000.

Config.Name: 7. LAN TLS private key
Config.Description: Required for LAN HTTPS: the matching unencrypted PEM private key. Restrict host permissions and keep this mapping read-only.

Config.Name: 8. Management UI
Config.Description: Authenticated Route Manager Lite web interface. Open it from the WebUI link after the container is running.

Config.Name: 9. LAN HTTP fallback
Config.Description: Optional bundled Caddy HTTP listener that redirects to HTTPS. Leave unused if another LAN proxy owns this port.

Config.Name: 10. LAN HTTPS fallback
Config.Description: Optional bundled Caddy HTTPS listener. Leave unused if an existing LAN proxy owns this port; discovered proxies are never overwritten automatically.
